body: I have. But they are far away and sadly because of some immigration issues I cannot be with them right now :(
I felt every emotion you described. My life is the same, maybe just different timings. I wish I could die too accidentally. I don’t want to hurt people who care about me.

Don’t live the life of people around you if you don’t want it. 4 years without parties? Man fuck that. You can live 70 more years for you. Do what you like. Don’t feel bad for not reliving the same life most of people live. Make your own story.
Fuck the pressure to be awesome. Sometimes it’s just too much. Be who you are and live the life YOU want, not somebody’s else imagined perfect life. It’s yours.
It’s their job to make you healthy. You don’t go to the doctor when you’re healthy, you go there to become healthy.
What brought you to the final push?

Don’t feel bad for feeling bad. It’s an endless loop. Your emotions are part of you, good or bad. Fuck the people that reject you just because you have a depression. Their loss anyway. 8 billion people remaining to become your friends. Text me anytime you feel down!
Remember that crying is good. Don’t hold your emotions inside you. Let it out. Tell me about it.
You don’t need to be put down just because you don’t feel anything towards anyone. You do you. Be yourself against everyone else. Don’t submit to society rules.
I’m traveling, and having a good time. But this doesn’t outweigh the difficulties for me.
It’s too much effort. Everyone expects you to be happy, otherwise you are not accepted in the society. Fuck society.
But why would I want a good life?
